mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 10% signals improving labor market conditions, which increases consumer confidence and spending, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE is below 10%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0, combined with a concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE), signals a supply-side contraction and weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars, combined with a stable or declining unemployment rate, indicates robust consumer demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the CPIAUCSL above 255.0, combined with a stable or rising federal funds rate, signals accelerating inflation that triggers monetary tightening expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 132,000 thousand, combined with a declining unemployment rate, signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) following a prior contraction, combined with a stable or rising industrial production (INDPRO), indicates a recovery in aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
